D-05: RequireAuth guards protected routes and preserves return path in state.from.
D-06: RedirectIfAuthed prevents authenticated users from viewing login/signup.
D-07: Implement LoginPage, SignupPage, HomePlaceholder, and OnboardingPlaceholder screens.
D-08: Ensure screens use minimal, unstyled semantic HTML with accessible tap targets.
D-09: Sign-up handles password length validation, calls signUp, and shows email confirm notification.
D-10: Login calls signIn and redirects to origin path or home.
D-11: Logout calls signOut and redirects to /login.
D-12: Form errors display in role=alert element and submit button disables on flight.
D-13: All authentication calls go through frontend/src/services/auth.ts.
D-14: Foundation contracts in services, lib, and types remain unmodified.
D-15: App.tsx wraps router while legacy views and api.ts remain in place unrouted.
D-16: Migration 20261120000200_explicit_grants.sql grants explicit schema and table access.
D-17: test-db.mjs executes all migrations in sequence and passes without blanket grants.
D-18: CONTRACT.md and backend/README.md document the explicit grants migration.
D-19: .gitignore ignores frontend/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo and build cache is untracked.
